snippet.title: Wishlist Trailer | May and the Amazing Bouquet
snippet.description:
Help May to obtain the Eight Prized Flowers in this cozy pixelated top-down action adventure! 🌼Explore her island home, meet new people, avoid shadowy creatures, solve puzzles, and collect whatever useful objects you can find!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734760/
Follow for Updates: https://bsky.app/profile/maygame.bsky.social
